purpose: Local provenance record for the frozen external capture. The digest pins the exact bytes of the capture file, so an edit to the external tier buckets or to the label-to-unit resolution is detectable instead of silent. This is deliberately one file and one digest; it is not a provenance framework.

source.name: Pro Game Guides — Anime Expeditions tier list (best units)

regenerate: Only when the publisher publishes a new tier-list revision: re-read the live page, rewrite the capture by hand from that page, re-run prettier, then replace sourceCaptureSha256 with the new digest. Never regenerate the capture from repository data.
notCapturedHere: No live network call runs in CI; this file is the network-free stand-in for the publisher page.
No repository file may be used as an input when writing this capture.
